_doc: Orc gait B, the HIGH variant (Mike 2026-10-17: 'a good variation'), a bigger brawler: hunched, head pushed forward with the chin up, anterior pelvis tilt, knees never straight, wide bow-legged stance with toes out 25 deg, heavy bent arms, sway 2x vanilla. Limp: the mildest of the three (bigger orcs drag less, per Mike's first brief): weak LEFT leg, strong RIGHT leg, low leading right shoulder, 55/45 timing. Exported as taom_orc_b_ (as_orc_warrior_b). Read by tools/blender/restyle_human_clip.py. Angles in degrees, distances in metres.
